translations.web: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.
translations.bsb: Righteous Father, although the world has not known You, I know You, and they know that You sent Me.
translations.kjv: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.
translations.asv: O righteous Father, the world knew thee not, but I knew thee; and these knew that thou didst send me;
